recommended_resolution: at least 1200 × 800 px (Resource Center); 'bigger is better' (Help Center)
orientation_or_aspect: landscape/horizontal; Airbnb auto-crops photos to squares in search results and on the listing
content_rules: Content Policy covers photos incl. AI-generated or AI-edited content; bans superimposed logos/links/company names advertising another business, content that identifies the listing's location, IP/privacy violations, explicit or violent content.
cover_photo_rule: First photo is the large one shown in search; first five photos appear prominently; host picks cover via 'Make cover photo'.
notes: Stays (homes) only. Minimum count (5) comes from a Resource Center article, not a Help Center rule. 1200 × 800 and 'up to about 10 MB' are recommendations in the Resource Center; no hard file-size limit or format list stated. Airbnb Experiences use different rules (help/article/3024: vertical, ≥800 × 1,200 px, ≤10 MB, ≥5 photos).

content_rules: May reject: text overlays (URLs, contact info), graphic overlays (logo watermarks, borders), collages/montages, black-and-white or sepia, blank/duplicate/near-duplicate, blurry/pixelated (avoid Portrait Mode), close-ups, non-photos (documents, illustrations; floor plans OK, area maps not).
cover_photo_rule: First photo is what travelers see in search results; Vrbo's AI Automatic Photo Order may choose a different hero image unless turned off.
notes: Fewer than 6 photos for more than 30 days can lead to indefinite suspension. Multi-unit properties need at least 1 exterior, 1 interior/lobby, 3 guest room and 1 bathroom photo. Duplicates don't count. No file-size limit stated on the English page read.

recommended_resolution: 4000 × 3000 px preferred (requirements page); ideally 2048 × 1536 px (upload article)
max_file_size: 1.3 MB (Extranet upload article); 50 MB (Connectivity Photo API)
file_formats: JPEG, BMP (Extranet upload article); JPEG, PNG (Photo API)
orientation_or_aspect: landscape (horizontal) only; 360° photos 2:1 and at least 1280 × 900 px
content_rules: Avoid grainy/blurry, over-processed, heavy filters/HDR, collages, watermarks or illustrations, skewed/distorted, black-and-white, fisheye. Avoid images focused on contact info or where people are the main focus. Personal ID data (IDs, bills, contracts) not allowed.
cover_photo_rule: Partner sets a 'preferred main photo' in Extranet; via API the first uploaded photo becomes main by default; main photo can only be deleted when the property is closed.
notes: Official pages conflict: Extranet upload article says JPEG/BMP, ≤1.3 MB, ideally 2048 × 1536; Photo API says JPEG/PNG, ≤50 MB, max 14000 × 14000 px. Also asks ≥4 photos per room/unit + ≥1 bathroom; condo hotels ≥24. Covers all Booking.com property types (hotels and vacation rentals).

recommended_resolution: 2,880 px or more on the longest side
content_rules: May be rejected for text/graphic overlays, borders, inappropriate material, close-ups, logos/maps/floor plans/illustrations, collages, B&W or sepia, blurry/pixelated. Policy bans contact/personal data, door codes, exact rental addresses; covers AI-generated content.
notes: Specs are from Expedia Group's connectivity (Image/Property API) docs, not a Partner Central help article (Partner Central help is login/JS-gated). Images below an unstated minimum resolution are REJECTED. Recommends ≥4 photos per room type + 1 bathroom, 1 exterior, 1 entrance/lobby, 1 per key amenity. A 'propertyFeatured' flag exists in the API but no rule text.

file_formats: 'consistent with generally accepted industry standards' (no list)
content_rules: Photos must be clear and accurate, of the property's interior/exterior; 2D/3D floor plan renderings allowed. Prohibits third-party intellectual property or contact information in photos (names, numbers, addresses, logos).
notes: Applies to Zillow Rentals (Rental Manager / rentals network) only. Max dimensions 9459 × 9459 px. Zillow help-center articles (zillow.zendesk.com, zillow.com/z/info/photo-uploading-tips) were blocked (403 / bot challenge) so file size, formats and recommended size could not be verified. For-sale agent listing photos come via MLS feeds; no Zillow spec read.

min_resolution: 2,048 px on longest side (smaller 'may be rejected')
recommended_resolution: at least 2,048 px on the longest side
file_formats: JPG/JPEG, PNG (GIF also listed in one help article)
max_photos: Displayed photos depend on ad package: Basic 5, Silver 20, Silver Plus 25, Gold 35, Gold Plus 40, Platinum 50, Platinum Plus 55, Diamond/Diamond Plus unlimited; uploads unlimited
orientation_or_aspect: horizontal/landscape; vertical may be cut off top and bottom
content_rules: Color only (B&W rejected), minimal filtering; no blurry/distorted images or special effects/animation; no superimposed text, graphics or logos; images showing phone, email or URL are deleted; must own the images; captions required.
notes: Format conflict: article 266 lists JPG/JPEG, GIF, PNG; guideline article 560 and photo T&C say JPG or PNG only (560 discourages GIF animation). Package photo limits are from the multi-family upload article. Pages blocked to plain HTTP clients; read in a browser.

content_rules: Owner-uploaded photos: no sexual, violent or medical content; no advertisements (incl. rental ads, FSBO); no photos showing only people; no children 13 or younger; no large group photos. Screened by Google safe-image software.
cover_photo_rule: MLS listings: first MLS photo is always shown (hero shot); no rule for Rental Tools listings.
notes: Min 5 photos applies to Redfin Rental Tools listings. Content rules and a 20-image limit are stated for owner-uploaded home photos (My Homes), not explicitly for rental listings, so max_photos left empty. Redfin states no pixel/format/size specs. For-sale photos come from MLS.

content_rules: Must match listing details, be clear and well-lit, show only areas the traveler can access, reflect current condition. Misleading, outdated or heavily edited images may be removed. Advises avoiding people/pets and not revealing the exact address.
cover_photo_rule: Landlord stars a 'featured photo', which appears first; best practice is to start with a clear exterior photo.
notes: Uploads in batches of up to 10. Video upload not supported. Mid-term (monthly) furnished rentals. Read in a browser (403 to plain HTTP clients).

content_rules: In focus and well lit; no significant alterations or excessive filters or AI; image should represent reality. Must follow GBP photos/videos content policy (prohibited and restricted content).
cover_photo_rule: Owner can set a cover photo, but it may not show first; a low-quality cover may be replaced by a user-submitted photo.
notes: 'AI' wording is on answer/6123536; answer/6103862 says alterations/filters only. Photos show only after verification; may take 24–48 h. Applies to hotels/rentals/venues with a Business Profile too.

file_formats: GIF, JPG, BMP, PNG (Business Advantage photos: JPG, PNG, GIF)
orientation_or_aspect: landscape generally looks better; recommended aspect ratio between 1:1 and 4:3
content_rules: No logos, promotional or commercial material on a property's listing; no images from other sources/infringing; not blurry, dark, sideways; not altered in a way that distorts the scene; must relate to the listed property.
cover_photo_rule: Cover Photos (Business Advantage subscribers) let owners pick the photos guests see first; Favorite Photos: pick 5–30 images, landscape recommended.
notes: Media Guidelines apply to all uploaders (travelers and owners). 1060 × 450 minimum and Cover/Favorite Photos apply to paid Business Advantage tools only. Read in a browser (403 to plain HTTP clients).

content_rules: High-res, well lit, undistorted photos of the space itself; no screenshots or low-res images; no watermark of any kind; no business names or logos; AI-generated content not allowed on listings.
cover_photo_rule: Tip: use the cover photo to show the activity type (Meeting, Event, Production); first five media items should be photos (videos/tours can't be in the first five).
notes: Photo article updated 15 June 2026. Recommends 20+ photos. Videos only as YouTube/Vimeo/Matterport links. No pixel or file-size spec stated.
